arabic text: KHATOON KA CHAAND KAHAAN HAI\nAABA D HAI DUNIYA SE AREE, MAGAR\nZAHRA KA CHAMA NA VEERAN HAI
english translation text: O moon of Muharram, tell me: where is\nthe moon of the noble Lady? The world\nremains inhabited, but Zahra's garden is desolate.

arabic text:
DEKHA NA SUNA ZAHID AISA,
ZAKHMON SE BADAN HAI CHOOR MAGAR
JA ARI HAI ZABAAN PE ZIKRE KHUD A,
GARDAN PE KHANJAR RAWAN HAI
english translation text:
O worshipper, none has ever seen or heard of such a one:
his body was shattered by wounds,
yet remembrance of God continued upon his tongue
while the dagger moved across his neck.

arabic text:
KEHTI THI SAKINA AABID SE,
IS QAID MEIN MAIN MAR JAUN GI
CHOORON AAKELA BHAI,
MUJHE ANDHERA BOHOT ZINDAGI HAI
english translation text:
Sakina said to Abid:
I will die within this prison.
Do not leave me alone, brother;
this darkness is unbearable.

arabic text:
ZANJEERO MEIN JAKDE HAI ALI,
HAI TOQ O SALASIL GARDAN ME
LEKIN BEEMAR KO KHINCH CHHADTA HAI,
TAREEKH ISKI GAWAH HAI
english translation text:
Ali's descendant is bound in chains,
with collar and shackles around his neck;
yet history bears witness
that the ailing Imam preserved the faith.

arabic text:
AY KUFIYON MEIN HOON BINTE ALI,
AUR WARIS CHADAR ZAHRA KI
DEKHO NA TAMASHA SHARM KARO,
AB ZAINAB KA SAR URIYA HAI
english translation text:
O people of Kufa, I am Ali's daughter
and heir to Zahra's chadar.
Do not stand watching—have shame;
Zainab's head is now uncovered.

arabic text:
AANKHON KI BASARAT AB TO NAHI,
MAWLA YE KAHAN AANKHON SE JAAATE HAIN
MUMKIN HAI YE AWA AZA AAYI,
BARCHI AKBAR KO LAA GI HAI
english translation text:
My eyesight has now faded.
Maula, where are you going beyond my sight?
Perhaps this voice has come
because the spear has struck Akbar.

arabic text:
BA ABA AAWO DEKH O TO ZARA,
JAATE HAIN ASGHER MAQTAL MEIN
ROTI HAI FAWJE SAAR, MAGAR,
ASGHER KE LABON PE HASEEN HAI
english translation text:
Baba, come and behold:
Asghar is being taken to the battlefield.
The entire army weeps,
yet Asghar smiles.

arabic text:
TANVEER UTHAA KAR ASGHER KO,
SAYYAD NE SAWAALE AAB KIYA
TUM BHI TO MUSALMAAN REHM KARO,
BESHIR KI KHUSHK ZABAAN HAI
english translation text:
O Tanveer, lifting Asghar,
the Sayyid asked for water.
You too are Muslims—show mercy
upon the speechless infant's dry tongue.
